messages:
customer_janet: Hey team — urgent SSO break for customer AcmePay after their IdP rotated certs. Users hit "Invalid SAML Signature" on redirect to /auth/sso/acs. Started ~2026-03-12 14:02 UTC. I have the IdP metadata URL and a SAMLResponse sample.
support_adele: thanks — can you paste the metadata URL + the raw SAMLResponse (base64) and the exact SP ACS URL you expect? also any browser callback errors.
customer_janet: metadata: https://idp.acmepay.example/metadata.xml
SAMLResponse (truncated): PD94bWwgdmVyc2lvbj0n... (base64)
Expected ACS: https://app.redwood.example/auth/sso/acs
Browser shows: "SAML Assertion signature validation failed" and our logs show: "AssertionConsumerService URL mismatch" sometimes.
eng_sam: quick checklist: (1) verify the metadata KeyDescriptor has a signing cert (not only encryption), (2) confirm the cert fingerprint we're seeing vs the SAMLResponse signature cert, (3) check ACS exact-match incl trailing slash and querystring.
sre_devon: deploy-bot says our metadata-fetcher ran at 2112345600 and returned 200, but thumbprint changed. @deploy-bot can you paste the fetch response headers? 
deploy-bot: metadata-fetcher/1.4.0 ran for acmepay at 2026-03-12T14:00:05Z -> 200 OK, Cache-Control: max-age=3600, ETag: "v12", Content-Length: 3421
eng_sam: ok that suggests caching could've kept old metadata for up to 1h. but signature errors imply either (A) the cert in metadata isn't the one used to sign the assertion, (B) the assertion was signed with a different algorithm (sha1 vs sha256), or (C) ACS URL mismatch.
support_adele: can you decode the SAMLResponse and grep SignatureMethod? run:
```
echo 'PD94bWwgdmVyc2lvbj0n...' | base64 -d | xmllint --format - | sed -n '1,120p' | grep -i SignatureMethod -A1
```
customer_janet: ran it, shows: `<ds:SignatureMethod Algorithm="http://www.w3.org/2000/09/xmldsig#rsa-sha1"/>` — so IdP signed with RSA-SHA1.
eng_sam: that's a likely culprit. We validate signatures with SHA256 by default for new installs; RSA-SHA1 will fail unless legacy algorithm support is enabled. Also check metadata KeyDescriptor: if the cert is marked as use="encryption" only, our validator may not pick it for signature validation.
customer_janet: metadata fragment:
```
<KeyDescriptor use="encryption">
  <KeyInfo><X509Data><X509Certificate>MIID...newcert...</X509Certificate></X509Data></KeyInfo>
</KeyDescriptor>
```
idp_admin: we rotated certs and updated metadata, but our IdP admin apparently only published the cert under encryption. we did not add the old cert back.
eng_sam: two immediate remediation paths:
- IdP: update metadata to include two KeyDescriptor entries: one with use="signing" containing the new cert, and include the previous cert as a signing key for overlap.
- SP (us): temporarily allow RSA-SHA1 verification for this tenant while IdP fixes metadata (not ideal, policy approval needed).
sre_devon: practical quick step: ask IdP to republish metadata with both certs and signing use. We can also force a metadata refresh from our side once they publish. I can run the refresh now — how? @support_adele any internal command?
support_adele: internal tool: `/support trigger-metadata-refresh acmepay` — runs fetch bypassing cache and logs result.
sre_devon: running it now... `/support trigger-metadata-refresh acmepay` -> fetch 200, metadata contains new KeyDescriptor with use="signing" now and two X509Certificate blocks. saving to staging.
eng_sam: verify cert fingerprints: save cert to file then run:
```
openssl x509 -in idp_cert.pem -noout -fingerprint -sha256
```
and compare to the certificate in the decoded SAMLResponse Signature KeyInfo. Also check signature algorithm in response.
customer_janet: idp_admin just confirmed they re-added old cert as signing cert and set proper use attributes. ran the refresh, tried login — success for one of the previously failing users. :thumbsup:
idp_admin: sorry about the churn — will add a 48h overlap policy next time. we also updated IdP to use RSA-SHA256 going forward.
eng_sam: summary/root cause: IdP rotated cert and mistakenly listed the new cert under KeyDescriptor use="encryption" only, and their new assertions briefly used RSA-SHA1 signature method. Our SP validation rejected the signature and some ACS requests also flagged URL mismatch due to an edge-case where redirect added a trailing slash. fix was: IdP republished metadata with signing cert(s) (old+new) and changed signing algorithm; we forced an immediate metadata refresh on our side.
support_adele: action items:
- Support: open KB for SSO cert-rotation runbook (include commands above). (adele)
- Eng: add a telemetry alert when metadata thumbprint changes for a tenant and when SignatureMethod != sha256 for >5% of assertions. (sam)
- SRE: add a hard-refresh endpoint to metadata fetcher for partner SLAs (devon)
customer_janet: please keep me posted on KB link; will follow up with AcmePay on their IdP rotation policy. thanks team!
sre_devon: closing loop: I configured the fetcher to treat max-age > 1800s for IdP metadata as advisory only when a manual refresh is requested, so future refresh will be faster.
support_adele: marking resolved for now; reopen if anything else pops up. :white_check_mark:
